name: Niagara Falls
source: USGS NY 3 County lidar merged with NY FEMA Region 2 Central lidar; NAVD88 metres. USGS 3DEP public-domain lidar, Entwine Point Tiles: https://s3-us-west-2.amazonaws.com/usgs-lidar-public/NY_3County_2019/ept.json and https://s3-us-west-2.amazonaws.com/usgs-lidar-public/NY_FEMAR2_Central_B1_2018/ept.json
facts: Niagara Falls is three waterfalls side by side: the Horseshoe Falls, the American Falls and the little Bridal Veil Falls.
The water comes from four of the Great Lakes. It rushes down the Niagara River, over the falls, and on to Lake Ontario.
axes: +X east, +Y up, +Z south; metres = int16 * scale; y = 0 is the water level
order: random (the first N points are an even subsample)
